title: Third Goat from the Left
author: The Bard of Bizarre
blurb: Bethlehem, the holy night. You are the goat nobody painted: eat your way out of the shepherds' fold, scream your fainting cousins stiff, get lost in the crowd, dodge the wise men's camels and take your place in the line at the manger, third from the left. Shareware from The Sofa BBS, based on the song by The Bard of Bizarre, one of his bizarre gospels (lyrics shaped by ChatGPT from Lewis Moten's prompt; recording and cover art made with Riffusion, now Google Flow Music).
